text: Figure 7.45: Dem and Dcm module requests PID data elements of SW-C via ReadData operation [SWS_Dem_00596] ⌈The Dem module shall provide access on PID data elements of the most important freeze frame being selected for the output of service $02 (OBD freeze frame of the event which caused MIL on) to the Dcm module (refer to Dem_ DcmReadDataOfOBDFreezeFrame).⌋ Note: The Dem processes and stores only the raw data for service $02. Any PID header-information and fill bytes are added by the Dcm. The Dcm configuration defines the individual PID layout, which also defines an order of the contained data elements.
